about: Every way a page reaches its browser, each tied to an acceptance check (packages/chromium/scripts/acceptance.mjs), a line of the release checklist, or why nothing of Bay's is involved. scripts/web-features.py checks it against the Chromium the engine builds: a hook or permission the table lacks, or one Chromium no longer has, stops the build.
